qs.en: You would keep your composure in this chaotic situation if you could.

qs.en: It's important that he holds his breath underwater.

qs.en: Hopefully you will remember the essence of the message during the presentation.

qs.en: The authorities must hold the offenders until judgment.

qs.en: The scientific community plays a crucial role in technological development.

qs.en: The religious communities of the country met to discuss peace.

qs.en: There is a very active artistic community in this neighborhood.

qs.en: The European Union community represents a unique political and economic alliance.

qs.en: This Catholic community has preserved ancestral traditions for centuries.

qs.en: Within the research community, people discuss the results of the latest experiments.

qs.en: I was interested in philosophy during my studies.

qs.en: This document will interest the experts tomorrow.

qs.s: Nous ___ nos collègues à ce projet l'année prochaine.

qs.s: Vous vous ___ à cette exposition la prochaine fois?

qs.en: This work would interest me if I had more time.

qs.en: I doubt that you would be interested in this kind of meeting.

qs.en: It is possible that this film interests them.

qs.en: This project interests me a lot because it touches on my passions.

qs.en: The legal matters concerning the inheritance concern us.

qs.en: This law affects all citizens of the country.

qs.en: I am becoming increasingly interested in environmental issues.

qs.en: She is really interested in archaeology and it is her passion.

qs.en: She is a biologist, in other words, she studies living organisms.

qs.en: We need to wait two days, that is to say, Tuesday or Wednesday, for an answer.

qs.en: The director announced budget cuts, in other words, we'll have to work with fewer resources.

qs.en: She speaks three languages fluently: French, English, and German, that is, the main European languages.

qs.en: Summer vacation, in other words, June, July, and August, is approaching rapidly.

qs.en: You must finish this project by Friday, that is to say, within the next four days.

qs.s: Il a obtenu une excellente note, _____ une note supérieure à 90%, au contrôle de mathématiques.
qs.en: He got an excellent grade, in other words, a grade above 90%, on the math test.

qs.s: Elle ne peut pas venir cette semaine, _____ qu'il faudra reporter la réunion à la semaine prochaine.
qs.en: She cannot come this week, in other words, we'll have to postpone the meeting to next week.
